SideChatQuote.description: A passage of the conversation the side chat asks about.

agent.description: Who wrote the message, for the quote card's label.

message_id.description: The conversation's message the passage came from (its entry id).

entry_id.description: The conversation's entry to fork at. Default: its last user or assistant message (a reply still streaming is skipped).

quote.description: A passage the side chat asks about, recorded in `side_chat_quotes`.

session_id.description: The conversation to open a side chat of.

meta.description: The side chat's session record after it was tagged (as `session::get` answers it in `meta`).
